privileged_info_for_vlm: The target dive is the last dive dated September 2011. Note that while the prompt mentions 'Dive #8', the actual data file (SampleDivesV2.ssrf) may have different numbering (e.g., Dive #90); the VLM should prioritize the date 'September 2011' and the 'last' position in that timeframe. The location must be exactly 'Blue Hole' and the mode must be 'Freedive' (which may appear as 'Apnea' in some versions of the software).
